- Read `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` — check the layout, KPI cards, charts quality
- Read `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` — check the report presentation
- Read `src/pages/Pricing.tsx` — check pricing card quality

- Check `tailwind.config.ts` — what's the design system? Colors, fonts, spacing?
- Check `src/index.css` or global styles — any custom CSS?

- Is there a 404 page?
- Is there a loading/splash screen?
- Is there an onboarding flow for new users?
- Is there a "forgot password" page?
- Blog page (mentioned in nav)?
- Terms/Privacy pages (mentioned in footer)?

### 5. SEO & Meta
- Read `index.html` — check meta tags, title, description, OG tags
- Any sitemap or robots.txt?

### 6. Edge Function Quality
- Read `supabase/functions/analyze-url/index.ts` — check for obvious issues
- Read `supabase/functions/analyze-url/prompts.ts` — are the prompts solid?
- Read `supabase/functions/stripe-webhook/index.ts` — any gaps?

### 7. Mobile Responsiveness
- Check if pages use responsive breakpoints (sm/md/lg in tailwind classes)
- Check sidebar behavior on mobile

### 8. Accessibility
- Check for aria labels, keyboard nav, focus states in key components

Report EVERYTHING that needs work — be brutally honest. Group by priority: Critical (must fix before launch), Important (should fix soon), Nice to Have (post-launch).
